source_profile:
Thornhollow — Territorial sovereignty, indigenous resistance

Inciting event: Marquessa Elowen Harrowmont issues a lucrative timber concession based
partly upon deeds purchased from Wolter Grell of the Briarhearth Freeholds. The concession
encompasses several independent villages and a cultivated grove sacred to the Velthari.

The residents refuse to recognize the deeds.

Potential progression: Surveyors expelled → logging camps established under armed

This would put Elaris Fenbough's diplomatic approach under increasing pressure from Tavian
Briarhand and the more militant members of the Coalition.

Established foundations: Wolter Grell's dubious land deeds and the competing obligations of the
Blackthorns.
